title: Software Licences
description: Every licence on the SPDX License List — 740 identifiers from `0BSD` to `ZPL-2.1`, 32 of them retired — with the OSI-approved and FSF-libre flags, the canonical reference URL and the URL of the full licence text.

name.description: Full licence name as the SPDX list writes it

deprecated.description: True for retired identifiers, which still resolve

osiApproved.description: True when the Open Source Initiative approved the licence

fsfLibre.description: True when the FSF records the licence as free/libre. SPDX omits the flag unless it is true, so false means not recorded, not proven non-free

referenceNumber.description: Position in the SPDX list, as published

textUrl.description: Plain-text licence, null for the retired identifiers that no longer ship one

seeAlso.description: Upstream URLs SPDX records for the licence
